title.en: An Act Converting the Medina High School in the Municipality of Medina, Province of Misamis Oriental, into a National Comprehensive High School to be Known as the Medina National Comprehensive High School and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

text.en:
The provisions of Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Misamis Oriental, is further amended to read as follows:
"Oriental Misamis, eight assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
